dashboard.intro: The dashboard gives you a real-time overview of your school's activity.
dashboard.kpi_students: Total number of active students enrolled.
dashboard.kpi_teachers: Total number of teachers on record.
dashboard.kpi_sessions: Number of sessions scheduled for today.
dashboard.kpi_payments: Number of students with at least one overdue payment.
dashboard.kpi_revenue: Total payments collected during the current month.
dashboard.kpi_attendance: Average attendance rate across all sessions this month.
dashboard.tip: The revenue and attendance charts cover the last 6 months. Recent payments and sessions are shown at the bottom of the page.

students.intro: Manage all enrolled students — add, search, update status, promote to the next year, and print QR codes.
students.step1: Click 'Add student' in the top-right corner.
students.step2: Fill in the name, phone, parent phone, and assign a level / year / group.
students.step3: Click Save. The student is created with Active status and a unique QR code.
students.search_body: Use the search bar to find a student by name. The level and status dropdowns let you narrow the list further.
students.action_promote: Move the student to the next year within the same level (or asks for confirmation if it is the last year).
students.action_transfer: Move the student to a different group within the same year.
students.action_status: Switch between Active, Suspended, and Archived.
students.action_qr: Open or print the student's QR card — used for attendance scanning.
students.action_delete: Permanently remove the student and all associated data. This cannot be undone.
students.status_suspended: The student is temporarily inactive but remains in the system.
students.status_archived: The student has left. Their history is preserved but they no longer appear in active lists.
students.tip: Click any row to open the student's profile panel, which shows payment history and attendance stats.

teachers.intro: Add teachers, assign them to modules, and set their compensation rate.
teachers.step2: Enter the name, email, phone, and a default rate per session.
teachers.step3: Save. You can then open the teacher's profile to assign modules and set custom rates per module.
teachers.rates_body: Each teacher has a default rate per session. You can override this rate on a per-module basis from the teacher's profile panel.
teachers.tip: A teacher's earnings are tracked automatically in the Payroll page once sessions are closed.

structure.intro: Structure is the backbone of the app. Define it before adding students or sessions.
structure.tip: Modules are linked to levels, not groups — a module can be taught across multiple groups of the same level.

sessions.intro: Sessions are the individual class events. They can be one-time or recurring.
sessions.type_one_time: A single class on a specific date.
sessions.type_recurring: A series of classes that repeat daily or weekly until an end date.
sessions.step2: Select the teacher, module, and group.
sessions.step3: Set the start and end time.
sessions.step4: For one-time: choose the date. For recurring: choose recurrence, days of the week, and the start / end dates.
sessions.attendance_body: Each session has an attendance window. Open it when the class starts so students can scan in. Close it at the end — students who have not scanned are automatically marked absent.
sessions.tip: Deleting a recurring session gives you the option to delete just that occurrence or the entire series.

attendance.intro: Record who attended each session, either by QR scan or manually.
attendance.step1: Go to Attendance and select today's date.
attendance.step2: Choose the session from the dropdown.
attendance.step3: Click 'Open window' to start accepting scans.
attendance.step4: Students scan their QR code (paste, camera, or external scanner).
attendance.step5: Click 'Close window' when class ends — absent students are recorded automatically.
attendance.scan_paste_body: Focus the input field and paste or type the QR code value. Press Enter or click Scan.
attendance.scan_camera_body: Click Camera to activate the webcam scanner. Point it at the student's QR card.
attendance.toggle_body: After attendance is closed, you can still correct individual records by clicking on a student's Present / Absent badge in the table — it toggles to the opposite status.
attendance.tip: The attendance table auto-refreshes every 5 seconds while the window is open.

payments.intro: Track every payment made by students for their sessions.
payments.type_pack: A block of N sessions paid upfront. Sessions are consumed one by one.
payments.type_per_session: The student pays for each session individually.
payments.type_monthly: A flat monthly fee regardless of session count.
payments.status_current: 3 or more sessions remaining — no action needed.
payments.status_due_soon: 1 or 2 sessions remaining — the student should renew soon.
payments.status_overdue: 0 sessions remaining — the student must pay to continue.
payments.consume_body: For pack-type payments, open the payment detail panel and click 'Consume 1 session' each time the student attends a session.
payments.tip: The dashboard's Pending Payments counter shows how many students have at least one overdue payment.

payroll.intro: Track how much each teacher has earned and manage payment status month by month.
payroll.item1: Select a month to see each teacher's total earnings based on closed sessions.
payroll.item2: Click 'Mark as paid' once you have transferred the salary.
payroll.item3: The paid date is recorded and visible in the teacher's payroll history.
payroll.tip: Earnings are calculated automatically from closed sessions and the teacher's rate (or per-module override).

expenses.intro: Log all outgoing school expenses to track operational costs.
expenses.cat_bills: Electricity, water, internet, and other utility bills.
expenses.cat_other: Any expense that does not fit the above categories.
expenses.tip: The expense totals for the current month and all time are shown at the top of the page.

settings.intro: Configure the application's appearance, language, and user accounts.
settings.appearance: Switch between light and dark mode.
settings.language: Change the interface language (Arabic, French, English).
settings.profile: Update your own name, email, and password.
settings.users: Add or remove staff accounts for this school.
settings.role_admin: Full access — can manage users, structure, and all data.
settings.role_staff: Can manage day-to-day operations (students, sessions, payments) but cannot change users or school settings.
settings.tip: Each school has its own isolated data — users of one school cannot see another school's data.
